content:
For users considering switching from Windows to Mac, software limitations are virtually nonexistent. The Mac platform can not only run all major PC applications but also offers a wealth of practical apps exclusive to Mac.

The only major exception is gaming. However, the latest tests show that Windows games now run better on Mac than ever before, whether through official or unofficial channels……

Apple provides a dedicated game porting toolkit to help developers assess the performance of their Windows games on Mac, aiming to encourage and facilitate game porting to the Mac platform.

However, according to Macworld's Filipe Esposito, this toolkit has also been used by gamers to run Windows software unofficially on Mac. He himself is one such user, noting that the latest test version brings significant performance improvements, citing Grand Theft Auto V as an example.

I spent several days testing the game porting toolkit 4 beta on a MacBook Pro equipped with the M4 Pro chip, and found that the performance improvements fundamentally transform the experience of running demanding Windows games……Using the same M4 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of memory, the same game settings, and the same benchmark, the frame rate of GTA V increased from approximately 106 fps on GPTK 3 to approximately 176 fps on the GPTK 4 beta, an improvement of about 66%. The game runs smoothly at 2K resolution with medium-to-high quality settings.

He acknowledges that not every game will achieve such remarkable results, but he hopes these advances will encourage game studios to consider Mac as a viable platform.
